anmelden_fehler: Sign-in failed. Check your name and password.
registrieren_fehler: The account could not be created. Check your details.
registrieren_vergeben: There is already an account for this e-mail. Sign in instead.
fehler_netz: No connection to the server. Try again in a moment.
fehler_abmelden: Signing out did not work. Try again in a moment.
fehler_speichern: This could not be saved. Check your details.
fehler_arbeitszeit_pflicht: Working time stays on while the business has employees (duty to record, BAG 1 ABR 22/21).
pflicht_hinweis_text: Since {zeitpunkt} your business has employees. Their working time must be recorded (BAG, 13.09.2022, 1 ABR 22/21; § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 ArbSchG). That is why the Working time module is on now and stays on while the business has employees.
heute_ohne_arbeitszeit: Without employees Soll records no working time. Book your hours under Projects.
fehler_betrag: Enter an amount in euros, such as 3,200.00 or 13.90.
einladung_text: Hello {name}, you are invited to {betrieb} as {rolle}. Choose a username and a password; you need no e-mail address.
einladung_benutzername_hinweis: 3 to 30 characters: letters, digits, dot and underscore
einladung_fehler: The invitation could not be accepted. Check your details.
einladung_vergeben: This username is taken. Choose another one.
einladung_ungueltig: This link no longer works: it has expired, was used already or is unknown. Ask for a new one.
einrichtung_module_spaeter: · can be changed later under Settings
betrieb_text: The federal state sets the public holidays. Four questions decide what you see in Soll.
fragen_titel: Four questions, so you only see what you need
frage_schichten: Do you work in shifts or to a plan?
frage_kunden: Do you bill hours to customers?
frage_stempelort: Do you clock in at a fixed place, such as the entrance?
modul_arbeitszeit_text: Clocking in, checks against the Working Hours Act, closing the month, absences
modul_terminal_text: A tablet at the entrance for clocking in with a PIN
module_text: What your business uses. A module switched off leaves the navigation; its data stays.
standorte_text: Where people work. Each site gets the public holidays of its state and municipality.
standort_name_hinweis: Such as workshop, café or Altona branch
modelle_text: Pick the templates that fit and change only what differs.
vorlage_vollzeit_text: Spread evenly Monday to Friday · monthly salary
vorlage_teilzeit_text: Spread evenly Monday to Friday · hourly wage
vorlage_minijob_text: Hours by plan · hourly wage · recorded within 7 days (§ 17 MiLoG)
modell_lohn_hinweis: May stay empty and follow later
modell_fehlt: Use at least one working-time model.
mitarbeiter_text: Read a list from your spreadsheet or add people one by one. They are invited in the next step.
mitarbeiter_leer: Nobody added yet. You can also invite later.
csv_kein_kopf: Line {zeile}: the first line needs a column Name (or first and last name).
csv_zu_viele: Line {zeile}: at most 200 people at once.
csv_name_zu_lang: Line {zeile}: the name is longer than 100 characters.
csv_unlesbar: Line {zeile}: a quotation mark is never closed; the file cannot be read from here on.
csv_rolle_unbekannt: Line {zeile}: Soll does not know the role “{wert}”.
einladungen_text: Each person gets a link. Pass it on, for example in a chat; no e-mail address is needed.
einladungen_leer: Nobody on the list. You can invite later.
hinweis_pflicht: With employees, working time is required: working time must be recorded (BAG, 13.09.2022, 1 ABR 22/21).
hinweis_solo: Without employees you record project time only. If someone joins, Soll switches working time on.
hinweis_feiertage: A site in Bavaria, Saxony or Thuringia may have holidays of its municipality, such as the Peace Festival in Augsburg.
hinweis_terminal_standort: The terminal stands at a site: everyone clocks in there with their PIN.
hinweis_vorlagen: Durations in hours and minutes, wages in euros and cents. Soll checks the minimum wage per person later.
hinweis_dienstplan_soll: With the rota, the hours come from the shifts, as in a mini-job.
hinweis_csv_vorlage: One line per person, the first with the columns, such as: Name;Role. Without a role, Employee applies.
hinweis_links_einmal: You see the links only now. Each works for seven days and only once.
hinweis_terminal_pin: For the terminal you then give each person a PIN.
hinweis_danach_stempeln: Next: under Today everyone clocks in, takes breaks and clocks out.
hinweis_danach_dienstplan: Next: in the rota you plan the week's shifts.
hinweis_danach_projekte: Next: under Projects you add customers and jobs.
hinweis_danach_terminal: Next: the tablet at the entrance becomes the terminal; everyone clocks in there with their PIN.
stempeln_fehler: Clocking did not work. Please try again.
laden_fehler: This could not be loaded. Check the connection.
tag_nicht_hinterlegt: No rule version is on file for this day, so Soll does not check it.
soll_nicht_hinterlegt_text: No working-time model is on file for you yet; the business sets it under Times.
ausblick_pause_text: At least {minuten} minutes, from {uhrzeit} at the latest
ausblick_acht_text: From {uhrzeit} only if balanced on other days
befund_ruhezeit_verkuerzt: Rest period shortened, to be balanced
befund_ruhezeit_ausgleich_fehlt: Balance for the shortened rest period missing
korrektur_grund_hinweis: Required. The person sees who changed what, when and why.
korrektur_fehler_zeit: This time does not exist on that day.
korrektur_fehler_zukunft: A clock stamp cannot be in the future.
korrektur_fehler_abgeschlossen: The month is closed; a correction is only possible as a counter-entry.
korrektur_fehler_recht: You may not change this clock stamp.
korrektur_fehler_veraltet: The clock stamp was changed meanwhile. Reload the page.
monat_bestaetigung_veraltet: Confirmation no longer valid: changed since
monat_ausgesondert_text: This month was closed on {abgeschlossen}. Its content was removed on {datum} after the retention period of {jahre} years ended; the month stays locked.
monat_laeuft: This month is still running. You can confirm and close it once it is over.
monat_offene_tage: Open shift on {tage}: add the Gehen first, then confirm.
monat_pruefwert_text: Created when the month is closed and printed on {name}'s time sheet. If anything in this month changes afterwards, the check page shows the deviation.
monat_ohne_text: {name} has not confirmed this state. Give the reason; it is printed on the time sheet.
monat_fehler_offen: A shift is still open. Add the Gehen first.
monat_fehler_weiterlaufen: The last shift can still go on. You can close the month 9 hours after the last Gehen.
monat_abschliessbar_ab: You can close this month from {zeit}: until 9 hours after the last Gehen, the last shift can still go on.
monat_fehler_bestaetigung: The person has not confirmed this state.
monat_fehler_gegeneintrag_offen: This month is open: change the stamps directly.
monat_mail_gesendet: The time sheet is on its way by email.
monat_mail_keine_adresse: No email address on file: the time sheet is ready to download.
monat_mail_fehler: The email could not be sent. The time sheet is ready to download.
monat_mail_nicht_eingerichtet: Email is not set up: the time sheet is ready to download.
monat_gegeneintrag_text: The month stays as it is, with its check value. The counter-entry counts in the current month and appears on the time sheet and the check page.
pruefen_text: Enter the check value from your time sheet. Soll compares it with the business's records.
pruefen_fehler: Please enter the business and the check value.
pruefen_ok_text: {monat} of {name} at {betrieb} is as it was closed on {datum}.
pruefen_ausgesondert: Genuine, content removed after the retention period
pruefen_ausgesondert_text: {monat} at {betrieb} was closed with this check value on {abgeschlossen}. Its content was removed on {datum} after the retention period of {jahre} years ended.
pruefen_abweichung_tage: {monat} of {name} was changed after closing, on these days: {tage}
pruefen_abweichung_kette: The audit chain up to this check value is no longer the same.
pruefen_unlesbar: That is not a check value. It looks like this: Nr. 1234 · and 64 characters of 0 to 9 and a to f.
pruefen_unbekannt: The business does not know this check value. Check the business ID.
offline_ohne_netz: No connection. Your clockings stay on this device and are sent as soon as the network is back.
offline_wartend_text: Soll sends them by itself as soon as the network is back.
offline_abgelehnt: {art} at {uhrzeit}, no. {nummer}: the server did not accept this clocking. Add it with a reason if needed.
luecke_text: A clocking got lost on the way or was deleted on the device. Check the day and add it with a reason if needed.
abw_kinderkrank_hinweis: Note child {kind}: days of sickness benefit used up · {norm}
abw_antrag_gesendet_tage: Request sent: {tage}. Weekends and public holidays do not count.
abw_schichten_hinweis: You are on the plan in this time: {schichten}. Whoever approves sees it.
abw_krank_text: No diagnosis needed. The team only sees “away”.
abw_krank_gemeldet: Sick report saved. Get well soon!
abw_frist_ab_tag: From day {tag} of a sickness the business needs a certificate. Your doctor sends it to your health insurer as an eAU, and the business fetches it there · § 5 EntgFG
abw_frist_faellig: Certificate due on {datum} if you are still sick then · § 5 EntgFG
abw_grund_text: Only with a reason. {name} will see it.
abw_erinnerung: {name}, sick since {von}: fetch the eAU through your payroll program, due on {datum} · § 109 SGB IV
abw_erinnerung_ueberfaellig: {name}, sick since {von}: fetch the eAU through your payroll program, due since {datum} · § 109 SGB IV
abw_fehler_ueberschneidung: There is already an absence or a request for these days.
abw_fehler_abgeschlossen: The month is closed. It can only be corrected with a counter-entry.
abw_fehler_status: This is no longer possible in this state. Please reload.
abw_einstellung_text: From which day of a sickness the business asks for a certificate. The law says from day 4; earlier is possible if you ask for it (§ 5 Abs. 1 EntgFG).
erinnerungen_text: Soll reminds you when you forgot to clock out, a break is due or your month is waiting for your confirmation. Soll never clocks you out.
erinnerungen_geraet_nicht_verfuegbar: Notifications do not work on this device. Install Soll as an app or use another browser.
erinnerungen_geraet_abgelehnt: Notifications are not allowed for Soll. Allow them in the browser's settings.
erinnerungen_ausstempeln_text: When your shift has been open longer than the business has set.
erinnerungen_pause_text: Shortly before a break is due under § 4 ArbZG.
erinnerungen_monat_text: When last month is over and you have not confirmed it yet.
erinnerungen_mail: By e-mail when no device receives it
erinnerungen_mail_text: Without a device with notifications, the reminder goes to your e-mail address.
erinnerungen_mail_keine: No mail can reach you: there is no e-mail address or the server sends no mail.
erinnerungen_regeln_pause_hinweis: 0 to 120 minutes before the break under § 4 ArbZG
erinnerungen_regeln_monat: Confirm the month from this day of the following month
erinnerungen_regeln_ungueltig: Please enter whole numbers within the limits.
plan_aufgenommen: Shift picked up. Arrow keys choose person and day, Enter drops, Escape cancels.
plan_bedarf_leer: No need for this site yet.
plan_ende_hinweis: An end before the start is on the next day.
plan_fehler_pause: The break is as long as the shift.
plan_fehler_rolle: Enter a role, such as service or kitchen.
plan_fehler_zeit: This time does not exist on that day (clock change).
plan_griff_hinweis: Enter picks up the shift, arrow keys choose the target.
plan_kein_standort: First add a site under Settings, then plan the week here.
plan_nichts_veroeffentlicht: Nothing has been published for this week yet.
plan_tag_leer: Nothing is planned on this day.
plan_vorlagen_hinweis: Drag a template onto a day:
plan_regel_r03: Average above 8 hours per working day, compensation needed
plan_regel_r06: Night work: working time above 8 hours
plan_regel_r07: Work on a Sunday or public holiday
plan_regel_r14: Monthly wage below the minimum wage
plan_regel_r15: Young workers: working time too long
plan_regel_r17: Young workers: shift span too long
plan_regel_r18: Young workers: time off between two days too short
plan_regel_r19: Young workers: work during the night rest
plan_regel_r20: Young workers: work on a rest day
plan_regel_r22: On-call work: too short notice or too short
plan_angaben_text: Only what a rule needs is stored. Soll does not ask whether someone is pregnant or breastfeeding.
pruefung_text: Without a setting, Soll checks against the strict default of the law.
pruefung_sonntag: Exception for Sundays and public holidays (§ 10 Abs. 1 ArbZG)
kiosk_koppeln_text: Enter the code the owner created under Settings.
kiosk_code_ungueltig: This code is not valid (any more). Ask for a new one.
kiosk_modul_aus: The terminal is switched off in this business.
kiosk_hinweis: Show your QR code or enter your PIN
kiosk_hinweis_karte: Hold your card to the tablet or enter your PIN
kiosk_hinweis_karte_qr: Hold your card to the tablet, show your QR code or enter your PIN
kiosk_karte_pin: Card read – now enter your PIN
kiosk_sperre_hinweis: After five wrong tries the terminal waits for a while.
kiosk_unbekannt: PIN, card or QR code unknown. Tries left: {rest}
kiosk_gesperrt: Too many wrong tries. Possible again in {sekunden} s.
kiosk_gesperrt_heute: Too many wrong tries today. The terminal is locked until midnight.
kiosk_ohne_netz: No connection. The terminal reloads as soon as the network is back.
kiosk_karte_nochmal: No answer from the server. Please hold the card to the tablet again.
kiosk_antwort_fehlt: No answer from the server. It is unclear whether the stamp was saved: please check Today later or hold the card to the tablet again.
kiosk_abgeschlossen: This month is closed. Please ask at the office.
kiosk_fehler: That did not work. Please try again.
kiosk_neustart: An error occurred. The terminal restarts in a moment.
kiosk_qr_text: Hold your QR code in front of the camera.
kiosk_kamera_fehler: The camera is not available. Enter your PIN.
kiosk_offline_text: Choose what you want to stamp. The terminal keeps it and sends it as soon as the network is back. You will see your state on Today afterwards.
kiosk_gespeichert_text: The stamp waits on the terminal and is sent as soon as the network is back.
terminal_text: A tablet at the entrance becomes the terminal: create a code here and enter it on the tablet.
terminal_code_text: Open {adresse} on the tablet and enter the code. It holds once and until {uhrzeit}.
terminal_offline_luecke: Without network, numbers {first} to {last} are missing. Please check whether stamps are missing.
terminal_offline_abgelehnt: Not accepted without network: {art} at {uhrzeit}, no. {nummer} – {grund}
terminal_grund_ausweis_unbekannt: PIN, card or QR code unknown
terminal_grund_gesperrt: terminal locked until midnight (PIN not checked)
terminal_personen_text: At the terminal the PIN alone recognises the person, so each PIN exists only once in the business. Print the QR code right after issuing it.
terminal_pin_vergeben: Someone in the business already has this PIN. Choose another one.
terminal_qr_text: Print the code now: Soll does not store it and will not show it again. A new code makes this one invalid.
terminal_karten_text: A plain card recognises the person only together with their PIN, as its UID can be copied. An NTAG 424 DNA recognises them alone: Soll checks the card's SUN message with its keys.
terminal_karte_uid_hinweis_ntag: 7 bytes in hex, e.g. 04:A1:B2:C3:D4:E5:F6; an NTAG 424 DNA always has a 7-byte UID
terminal_karte_vergeben: This card is already entered in the business.
terminal_karte_ungueltig: UID or key invalid. An NTAG 424 DNA needs a 7-byte UID, and keys of all zeros (factory state) do not count.
datev_text: Agree the numbers with your payroll office. Only closed months are exported.
datev_lohnart_hinweis: Up to 4 digits; leave empty what does not occur in the business.
datev_fehler_format: Please enter digits only, in the length given.
datev_fehler_doppelt: Someone else already has this personnel number.
datev_export_text: Movement data for LODAS or Lohn und Gehalt. Closed months only: the numbers no longer change after the export.
datev_fehlend_titel: Not set – there is no file until then:
datev_fehlend_monat_offen: The month of {name} is not closed
datev_fehlend_lohn: Wage in the working-time model of {name} (for the surcharges)
datev_fehlend_negativ: The hours of {name} are below zero because of counter-entries
modell_zuschlaege_hinweis: In percent of the hourly wage; empty means no surcharge. 0 to 4 a.m. counts as night, 25 and 26 Dec and 1 May as holiday.
fehler_prozent: Enter a percentage, such as 25 or 12,5.
pruefexport_text: Working time per person and period for customs and labour inspection: start, end, breaks, duration, when recorded, changes with their reason, findings with their norm and the check value of each closed month.
pruefexport_fehler_zeitraum: The period runs from the first day to the last and covers two years at most.
auskunft_text: Everything Soll keeps about you in this business, as a JSON file: account, stamps with every change and reason, counter-entries, closings with their check value, working-time models, shifts, devices and the audit chain's entries about your data.
auftrag_budget_stunden_hinweis: For example 40 or 12:30, empty for none
saetze_vorrang: The most specific rate applies: activity before order before customer, on each level a person's rate before the one for everyone, then the person's own rate, last the one for everyone. Without a fitting rate it says “nicht hinterlegt”.
fehler_verwendet: Still in use: archive it instead.
zugaenge_text: With an access token, other programs and AI assistants read your times and clock in for you, through the REST API and the MCP server, with the rights of your role in this business. When you leave the business, your tokens end.
zugang_neu: Your new token. Copy it now: Soll shows it only this once.
stoppuhr_leer: Nothing is booked on this day.
stoppuhr_hinweis_titel: More project time than working time
stoppuhr_hinweis_text: Booked {gebucht}, clocked {gestempelt}: {ueber} more. A booking or a clock entry is wrong.
buchung_fehler_spanne: The end lies after the start, not in the future and at most 24 hours later.
buchung_fehler_abgerechnet: The booking is billed and can no longer be changed.
buchung_fehler_laeuft: The booking is still running. End it with Stop.
nachweis_kein_auftrag: A time report needs an order.
nachweis_leer: No open bookings on this order in this period.
nachweis_bemerkung_hinweis: Material and notes for the customer, optional.
nachweis_unterschrift_hinweis: Draw in the box with a finger, a pen or the mouse. Only the shape is kept, no speed and no pressure.
nachweis_teilen_fehler: Sharing did not work. Download the PDF.
nachweis_fehler_abweichung: A booking changed since the preview. Check the list and have it signed again.
nachweis_fehler_leer: There is no booking to sign.
nachweis_fehler_unterschrift: Enter the customer's name and have them sign.
buchung_fehler_unterschrieben: The booking is in a signed time report and can no longer be changed.
auslastung_text_team: Stamped working time against booked project time of a month. Soll shows the team only for months that have ended and from three people on, so no one can be singled out.
auslastung_text_eigene: Your stamped working time against your booked project time of a month.
auslastung_erklaerung: Present is the stamped working time without breaks. Billable is what is booked on an order with a billable activity, internal is everything else.
auslastung_zu_klein: Too few people: Soll shows a team's utilisation only from {mindestens} people with time in the month.
auslastung_monat_laeuft: The month is still running. The team's utilisation is shown once it is over.
auslastung_je_person_text: Shows owner and planners the numbers of every person and every person their own. All employees see that it is switched on. If your business has a works council, switch it on only with its consent (§ 87 Abs. 1 Nr. 6 BetrVG).
auslastung_je_person_nur_inhaber: Only the owner switches the evaluation per person on or off.
auslastung_hinweis: Evaluation per person is switched on since {seit}: owner and planners see your booked against your stamped time; you see it under Reports.
haben_zugang_text: Soll sends billed project time as services to your bookkeeping in Haben. In Haben, create a token under Settings → AI assistants and API with the rights “read contacts” and “create services”.
haben_token_hinweis: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
haben_token_gesetzt: A token is kept. Leave empty to keep it.
haben_nur_inhaber: The owner sets up the access to Haben.
haben_kontakte_text: Link each customer with its contact in Haben, or take a contact over as a new customer. Only the bookings of linked customers go to Haben.
haben_kontakte_leer: There are no contacts in Haben.
haben_uebergabe_text: What you hand over is billed and can no longer be changed; a correction is a new booking. Handing over again creates nothing twice in Haben.
haben_buchungen_leer: No finished bookings on this order in this period.
haben_uebergeben_hinweis: At most 100 at once: Haben takes 120 calls a minute.
haben_uebergeben_wartet: {anzahl} bookings are still waiting for Haben. Hand them over again later.
haben_fehler_fehlt: No access to Haben is set up yet.
haben_fehler_schluessel: The token cannot be decrypted: the server's key changed. Enter the token again.
haben_fehler_token: Enter the API token from Haben.
haben_fehler_adresse: Enter the address of Haben, e.g. https://haben.example.de.
haben_fehler_kunde: The customer of this order is not linked with a contact in Haben.
haben_fehler_zu_lang: A booking is longer than 24 hours; Haben does not take it like that. Correct it first.
haben_fehler_kontakt: Haben does not know this contact.
haben_fehler_abgerechnet: A booking was already billed without Haben and does not go into an invoice again.
haben_fehler_doppelt: This contact is already linked with another customer.
haben_fehler_zugang: Haben refuses the token: wrong, expired or revoked.
haben_fehler_recht: The token lacks a right in Haben: “read contacts” or “create services”.
haben_fehler_zu_viele: Too many calls to Haben. Try again in a minute.
plan_kalender_text: With this link your calendar app shows your published shifts and keeps them up to date. The link is secret: anyone who has it sees your shifts. Do not share it.
plan_kalender_neu_hinweis: A new link replaces the old one; the old one stops working at once.
plan_kalender_aktiv: You have had a link since {datum}.
plan_kalender_einmal: The link is shown only now.
konten_luecken: Not closed yet and not counted: {monate}
konten_ausgesondert: no longer complete: months removed after their retention period ({monate})
konten_topf_verfaellt: From {jahr}: {tage}, expires at the end of {datum} · {norm}
konten_topf_verfallen: From {jahr}: {tage} expired at the end of {datum} · {norm}
konten_topf_hinweis_faellig: From {jahr}: {tage}. Notice on expiry due by {datum} · {norm}
konten_topf_kein_verfall: From {jahr}: {tage}, does not expire: no notice in time · {norm}
konten_hinweis_text: Record the day you told {name} how much leave is open and when it expires. Without this notice no leave expires (§ 7 Abs. 3 BUrlG). {name} sees the notice in the app.
konten_anpassen_text: Only with a reason. {name} sees the change.
konten_fehler_widerspruch: This does not fit the account: overtime at the start only goes before the first closed month and any other change, leave left before Soll not from a year after a notice on expiry.
konten_fehler_nicht_hinterlegt: The leave account cannot be computed yet: a working-time model or a site is missing.
konten_fehler_ungueltig: Please check the day, month or year: nothing before joining, a notice not after today, a month at most this one, a year at most the next one.
umzug_text: Bring times, absences, customers and orders from your previous tool. Soll checks everything before the takeover and creates nothing twice on a second run.
umzug_werkzeug_frage: Which tool do you come from?
umzug_anleitung_soll_csv: A table in the Soll-CSV format: one line per time, absence, customer or order; the column Typ says what the line is. Download the template, fill it in Excel or another program and save it as CSV.
umzug_lese_kein_kopf: header with Typ and Kennung missing
umzug_lese_zu_viele: more than 20,000 records: split the file by months
umzug_lese_pause_ungueltig: break invalid or as long as the time
umzug_fehler_zu_gross: The file is larger than 5 MB.
umzug_fehler_gleichzeitig: Another import came first. Start the dry run again.
umzug_spalten_text: Which column of the file holds which value. Soll recognises the header in German and English.
umzug_personen_text: Map each person of the file to a person in Soll. The import creates no people: invite them first.
umzug_abgeschlossen_text: If months were already closed in the old tool, Soll closes them after the takeover: with the reason “übernommen aus …” and a check value, without the person's confirmation.
umzug_abgeschlossen_an: Months closed in the old tool
umzug_module_aus: Soll takes times and absences over only with the module working time, customers and orders only with the module project time.
umzug_befunde_text: This is how Soll checks the times taken over. The preview shows past violations but does not change them.
umzug_befunde_keine: No findings in the times of the file.
umzug_probelauf_text: The dry run shows what the takeover would create and writes nothing.
umzug_grund_person_unbekannt: person is not in the business
umzug_grund_zeit_gibt_es_nicht: time does not exist because of the clock change
umzug_grund_pause_ungueltig: break as long as the time
umzug_fertig: Taken over. The original file is kept under its SHA-256 {sha256}.
umzug_nicht_gesperrt: {anzahl} months could not be closed; a second run tries again.
umzug_grund_zuordnung_abweichend: taken over for another person already
umzug_grund_geaendert_im_alten_tool: changed in the old tool since Soll took it over
